ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human review as a safety/conduct case (SAFE-1): preserve chat log #1–#2 and the driver statement, interview both parties, and confirm whether the doors were locked while the vehicle was moving; remind the rider of the 995 / driver commercial-insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths if she wishes to pursue the conduct complaint.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety dispute: driver chat contains threat/intimidation language ("Sit down or I lock the doors") detected as a threat keyword [F4][F5] after the rider asked to stop and get out [F3]; driver claims the rider tried to open the door while moving [F6]. SAFE-1 bars automatic adjudication — human review required.
